lines.en: I begin my journey to that one place the same way I’ve begun at least three other journeys in my past.
lines.zh: 我以和过去至少三次旅程相同的方式，开始了前往那个地方的旅程。

lines.en: The only difference is that the sun has gone into hiding for the time being and TV static has taken its place.
lines.zh: 唯一的区别是，太阳暂时躲了起来，电视雪花噪点取代了它的位置。

lines.en: I gaze up at the sky and wonder how things would be if the cable company would show up and reorganize the coaxial cables or whatever it is that delivers moving pictures to the giant rectangle called “world.”
lines.zh: 我仰望天空，想着如果有线电视公司能来重新整理一下同轴电缆、或者随便那根把活动画面输送到「世界」这个巨大长方形上的东西，事情会变成什么样。

lines.en: I fall through the map to confirm where I am, but only confirm that I know even less than I did about my surroundings ten minutes ago.
lines.zh: 我掉出地图之外来确认自己的位置，结果只确认了一件事：我对周围环境的了解，比十分钟前还要少。

lines.en: How come everything always has to be so confusing?
lines.zh: 为什么所有事都非得这么让人摸不着头脑？

lines.en: How come everything I walk over has to collapse and send me descending into a realm beyond our imagination, filled with invisible hands and half eaten watermelons?
lines.zh: 为什么我每走过的地方都非要塌陷，把我送进一个超乎想象的领域，里面满是看不见的手和吃了一半的西瓜？

lines.en: Just bring me back to Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 把我带回 Kumon-mi 就行了。

lines.en: I’m tired of being below it.
Something somewhere hears my wish and reconnects me to the world I am more familiar with.
lines.zh: 某个地方的某个存在听见了我的愿望，把我重新接回了我更熟悉的那个世界。

lines.en: My legs disagree with my mind’s desire to move forward, however, and start dragging me toward a bad place.
lines.zh: 然而我的双腿不同意我脑子里向前走的念头，开始把我往一个糟糕的地方拖。

lines.en: : Stfu man. You always get to be the one who decides where we go and what we do. Let us take over for once.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴吧老兄。去哪儿、干什么，从来都是你说了算。这次换我们来。

lines.en: Shortly after entering this world, I learned that my right leg was born with some sort of neurological deficiency and would only be able to communicate through numbers.
lines.zh: 进入这个世界后不久，我就得知我的右腿天生带有某种神经缺陷，只能通过数字交流。

lines.en: I’ve never been able to understand him as a result of this.
lines.zh: 因此，我一直没能听懂他在说什么。

lines.en: : Anyway, we can’t go to the[school] yet.
lines.zh: : 总之，我们现在还不能去[school]。

lines.en: : Bruh, Maya isn’t even there yet. We’ve gotta give her some time.
lines.zh: : 兄弟，Maya 都还没到呢。我们得给她点时间。

lines.en: : How do you know that, left leg?
: You broke out mad quick this time, man. There’s no way she’d be there yet.
lines.zh: : 你这次出来得快得离谱，老兄。她不可能已经在那儿了。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re getting better and better at this shit yo.
lines.zh: : 对。你干这个越来越熟练了，哟。

lines.en: : Now, can you shut the fuck up for a minute and let me get back to my job?
lines.zh: : 行了，你能不能闭嘴一分钟，让我回去干活？

lines.en: : Ayo FUCK Right Leg. You think I care about that numbers shit? Nah. We’re going to the old district.
lines.zh: : 哎哟，去他的右腿。你以为我在乎那堆数字玩意儿？才不。我们要去老城区。

lines.en: I follow the order of my legs and surrender my well-being to their desires, as I am incapable of moving anywhere without their permission.
lines.zh: 我听从双腿的命令，把自己的安危交给它们的欲望，因为没有它们的许可，我哪儿也去不了。

lines.en: I find it best to give into the desires of my body and completely detach my sentience whenever I can.
lines.zh: 我发现最好的办法就是顺从身体的欲望，只要有机会就彻底切断自己的意识。

lines.en: It helps me avert the blame for all of the horrible things I consciously decide to do and-
lines.zh: 这样能帮我甩掉那些我有意识决定去做的可怕事情的罪责，而且——

lines.en: : When daytime ended, you fucking moron.
lines.zh: : 白天结束的时候啊，你这个白痴。

lines.en: : Stop being so mean. I want to talk to Right Leg instead.
lines.zh: : 别这么凶嘛。我想跟右腿说话。

lines.en: : Omfg I can’t even with you anymore.
lines.zh: : 我的天，我真是受够你了。

lines.en: My left leg dislocates itself from my body and hops down the street as quickly as a single disembodied leg can.
lines.zh: 我的左腿从身体上脱臼下来，以一条孤零零的腿所能达到的最快速度沿街蹦走了。

lines.en: I’m left to crawl around the old district in search of anyone I’m familiar with but, to the dismay of myself and Right Leg, I find absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 只剩下我在老城区里爬行，寻找任何我熟悉的人，但令我和右腿失望的是，我什么也没找到。

lines.en: /////////////////////////////YOU KNOW WHERE YOU NEED TO GO
I’m assaulted by a migraine and immediately forget the last two lines of dialogue I {s}read{/s} experienced.
lines.zh: 一阵偏头痛袭击了我，我立刻忘掉了刚刚{s}读到的{/s}那两行对话。

lines.en: I look down and notice that my left leg had reattached itself within the time it took for my brain to signal to itself that it was in pain.
lines.zh: 我低头一看，发现左腿已经在我大脑把疼痛信号传给自己所需的那点时间里重新接了回去。

lines.en: Which is actually pretty unsurprising given how short of a distance that message had to travel.
lines.zh: 考虑到那条信息要传递的距离有多短，这其实一点也不奇怪。

lines.en: : I saw some shit, man. We gotta get out of here.
lines.zh: : 我看到不该看的东西了，老兄。我们得离开这儿。

lines.en: : Have you learned your lesson or are you going to detach yourself from my body again?
lines.zh: : 你吸取教训了吗，还是打算再从我的身体上脱离一次？

lines.en: : Please, get me out of here.
: Fine. But {i}I’m{/i} making the rules from now on.
lines.zh: : 行。不过从现在起由{i}我{/i}定规矩。

lines.en: Daylight returns and winter becomes summer.
lines.zh: 白昼回来了，冬天变成了夏天。

lines.en: It’s only momentary, though, as winter returns seconds later.
lines.zh: 不过那只是暂时的，几秒之后冬天又回来了。

lines.en: Maybe I’ll get really lucky and feel both of them at the same time soon enough.
lines.zh: 也许我运气够好，很快就能同时感受到两者。

lines.en: Hot will become cold and cold will become hot and-
lines.zh: 热会变成冷，冷会变成热，然后——

lines.en: Wait. I think that would just make the temperature moderate or something.
lines.zh: 等等。我觉得那样只会让温度变得适中什么的。
难道不是每种温度都是{i}温和{/i}的吗？

lines.en: I don’t know anything at all.
{i}Congratulations! You have advanced to the next line of the script!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你已经推进到剧本的下一行！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please remember to subscribe on SubscribeStar so Lessons in Love can become the new standard of religious education in public[school]s all across the US!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}请记得在 SubscribeStar 上订阅，让《Lessons in Love》成为全美公立[school]宗教教育的新标准！{/i}

lines.en: {i}For more information, please contact your local library!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}更多信息，请联系你当地的图书馆！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Approach the counter with tears in your eyes and say nothing but, “Help me.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}含着泪走到柜台前，什么也别说，只说一句「救救我」。{/i}

lines.en: Lay your hands upon the most sacred of bodies, whichever they may be in your eyes, and say “Good job!”
lines.zh: 把手放在最神圣的躯体之上——在你眼中无论那是哪一副——然后说一句「干得好！」

lines.en: Make your gods happy or they will make your life miserable!
lines.zh: 让你的神开心，否则他们会让你的生活痛苦不堪！

lines.en: Your existence will leave no impact on this world and, sooner or later, we’ll all just wind up flowing into one another anyway!
lines.zh: 你的存在不会在这个世界上留下任何影响，而且迟早，我们所有人都会彼此交融在一起！

lines.en: Why not have a little fun on the way out?
lines.zh: 何不在退场之前找点乐子呢？

lines.en: I show up at[school] to find the hallway filled with boxes.
lines.zh: 我来到[school]，发现走廊里堆满了箱子。

lines.en: Would you like to open one?
I’m incapable of opening any of the boxes for reasons beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: 出于我无法理解的原因，我一个箱子都打不开。

lines.en: I decide to stand still instead, seeing as there is no feasible way for me to move past this barrier.
lines.zh: 既然没有任何可行的方法能让我越过这道障碍，我决定就这么站着不动。

lines.en: : We meet for the nth time!
lines.zh: : 我们第 n 次见面了！

lines.en: Two mysterious white figures with blank faces claim to know me, but I don’t know them at all.
lines.zh: 两个脸上空白的神秘白色人影声称认识我，可我根本不认识它们。

lines.en: They do a little dance and it’s actually kind of cute.
lines.zh: 它们跳了一小段舞，其实还挺可爱的。

lines.en: I dance along with them and uncover a skill I didn’t know I had.
lines.zh: 我跟着它们一起跳，并解锁了一个我不知道自己拥有的技能。

lines.en: {i}Dance: (17 Hour Cooldown) Empower your allies with the willpower they need to make it through the day without contemplating how the world would change if they stopped existing.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}舞蹈：（17 小时冷却）赋予你的盟友撑过这一天所需的意志力，让他们不会去想：如果自己不存在了，世界会变成什么样。{/i}

lines.en: {i}[[Dance] may also be used to prime players of the opposite sex for mating during mating season!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}[[Dance] 也可以在交配季节用来为异性的玩家做好交配准备！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please check the in-game calendar for upcoming special events like “Mating season” and “Buzzsaw fest!”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}请查看游戏内日历，了解即将到来的特别活动，比如「交配季节」和「电锯狂欢节」！{/i}

lines.en: : He dances like a filet of fish!
lines.zh: : 他跳起舞来像一块鱼排！

lines.en: : Don’t you mean “fish out of water?”
lines.zh: : 你说的不是「如鱼离水」吗？

lines.en: : He can’t even form proper sentences!
lines.zh: : 他连一句完整的句子都说不出来！

lines.en: : Can at least tell how box past get?
lines.zh: : 至少能告诉我怎么过箱子吗？

lines.en: : Sorry! But you are unable to go this way!
lines.zh: : 抱歉！但这条路你不能走！

lines.en: : This wing of the[school] is currently reserved!
lines.zh: : [school] 的这一侧目前已被预订！

lines.en: : Then how progress game need hint.
lines.zh: : 那怎么推进游戏需要提示。

lines.en: : You missed your chance to progress by not properly investigating before typing in the answers!
lines.zh: : 你输入答案之前没有好好调查，所以错过了推进的机会！

lines.en: : Did you look up a guide or something?
lines.zh: : 你是不是查了攻略什么的？

lines.en: : Brain so small and don’t want think =(
lines.zh: : 脑子这么小还不愿意想 =(

lines.en: : There are plenty of other games out there more suited to people like you.
lines.zh: : 外面还有很多别家游戏更适合你这种人。

lines.en: : This world doesn’t want you anymore.
lines.zh: : 这个世界已经不想要你了。

lines.en: : It’s just a little depressing that Maya won’t get to see you make it to the roof this time.
lines.zh: : 只是有点遗憾，这次 Maya 看不到你爬上屋顶了。

lines.en: : She had a little picnic planned out and everything.
lines.zh: : 她连小小的野餐都准备好了，一应俱全。

lines.en: : Guess she’s just doomed to a life of hopeful abstinence and you’re doomed to close the application and get back to your normal depressing life.
lines.zh: : 看来她注定要过充满希望的禁欲生活，而你也注定要关掉程序，回到你那正常又压抑的生活里去。

lines.en: : I will leave bad review. That will teach lesson.
lines.zh: : 我要留差评。这会给你个教训。

lines.en: : A hint! A hint! A hint!
: A hint! A hint! A hint!
I begin to clap my hands along with the second figure.
lines.zh: 我开始跟着第二个人影一起拍手。

lines.en: The two of us dance in unison and develop a strong bond.
lines.zh: 我们俩动作一致地跳起舞，并结下了深厚的羁绊。

lines.en: {i}Your affection with Angel 2 has increased to 1!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你与 Angel 2 的好感度提升到了 1!{/i}

lines.en: : Fine, fine. You can have a hint.
Some loud noise that keeps scaring the shit out of me happens again and the two figures behind me dissolve into the ground like teeth down the back of an unsuspecting throat.
lines.zh: 那个一直把我吓得半死的巨响又出现了，我身后那两个人影像牙齿滑过毫无防备的喉咙深处一样，溶进了地面。

lines.en: Or cum, because cum is funnier than melting teeth.
lines.zh: 或者像精液吧，因为精液比融化的牙齿更好笑。

lines.en: I take a few minutes to think about cum and get a boner.
lines.zh: 我花了几分钟想精液的事，然后勃起了。

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : I am the guardian of the top floor.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : What is there that even needs to be guarded up there?
lines.zh: : 上面到底有什么值得守的？

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : But the white things told me that this is where I had to go and you’ve never even been here before.
lines.zh: : 可那两个白色的东西告诉我必须来这儿，而你以前根本没来过。

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : Can I talk to your manager?
lines.zh: : 我能跟你们经理谈谈吗？

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : I want to talk to your manager.
: I’m not looking for any trouble, man.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : Just tell me what it is you’re here to see and maybe we can work something out.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 告诉我你来这儿是想看什么，也许我们能商量出个办法。

lines.en: : Gotta give me a little more than that, bud.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 你总得多给点信息吧，朋友。
: 我是为了……某个东西来的。

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : Maybe something like a Christmas ornament?
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 也许像圣诞挂饰之类的？

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : I did see some girl go up there a little while ago.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 我确实看到有个女孩刚才上去了。

lines.en: : Walked right past me. Didn’t even say hello.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 从我旁边直接走过去了。连招呼都不打。

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : Yes. She is who I’m here to meet. And she can be very rude.
lines.zh: : 对。我来就是见她的。而且她可以非常无礼。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure she comes down and apologizes after we finish resetting the world together.
lines.zh: : 等我们一起把世界重置完，我一定让她下来道歉。

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : Isn’t it kinda nice having everybody gone?
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 大家都不在了不是挺好的吗？

lines.en: : There’s no noise. Everything is free.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 没有噪音。什么都是免费的。

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : But...then again...I’m a net with a knife nose and a melon mouth, so I don’t really know much about paradise.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 不过……话又说回来……我是一张长着刀鼻子和瓜嘴的网，所以我对天堂也不太了解。

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : Are we really playing that game right now?
lines.zh: : 我们真的要玩这个游戏吗？

lines.en: : Nope. We’re playing Lessons in Love. A game created by Selebus for the express purpose of saving the world.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 不。我们在玩《Lessons in Love》。一款由 Selebus 创造、明确以拯救世界为目的的游戏。

lines.en: : None of this is actually happening and it’s just all one big simulation.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 这一切其实都没有真正发生，全都是一场巨大的模拟。

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : I’ve just been getting really into theorycrafting lately and I’m pretty sure I have everything figured out.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 我只是最近沉迷理论推演，而且我很确定自己已经把一切都想明白了。

lines.en: : Sure, the game’s come out and told me that’s not the case like six hundred times, but there are also all of these recurring themes about perception and-
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 当然，游戏已经出来告诉过我六百次说不是那么回事，可里面还有所有这些关于「感知」的反复出现的主题，而且——

lines.en: : You know what? Just join the Discord. I’ve got some notes I can share with you on there and you look pretty busy right now.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？直接加 Discord 吧。我有些笔记可以在上面分享给你，而且你现在看起来挺忙的。

lines.en: : I just want to go upstairs.

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : Dude, just walk past me. I have no legs. What would I even do?
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 老兄，直接走过去啊。我没有腿。我还能干什么？

lines.en: : Well, you’re not really all there right now.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 嗯，你现在确实不太清醒。

lines.en: : Probably a side effect of slowly fading away or something.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 大概是正在慢慢消失的副作用之类的。

lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: : Seems to me like you might be hanging on by a thread and fighting against whatever forces are trying to make {i}you{/i} disappear as well as everyone else you know.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
lines.zh: : 在我看{i}来{/i}，你大概正命悬一线，同时在和那些想要让你、以及你认识的所有人消失的力量抗争。

lines.en: : But hey, that’s just a theory.
lines.spk: Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth
Net With Knife Nose & Melon Mouth

lines.en: Left leg and right leg join forces one final time as they carry my body up the stairs and past the guardian of the top floor.
lines.zh: 左腿和右腿最后一次联手，把我的身体抬上楼梯，越过了顶楼的守卫。

lines.en: My peripheral vision catches sight of a familiar television program as I ascend and I can’t help but become distracted for a moment.
lines.zh: 上楼时，我的余光瞥见一档似曾相识的电视节目，忍不住走神了片刻。

lines.en: I stop watching when I realize that I don’t know anyone on the screen.
lines.zh: 当我意识到屏幕上的人我一个都不认识时，就不再看了。

lines.en: One of them did have familiar eyes, though.
lines.zh: 不过其中一个人有一双熟悉的眼睛。

lines.en: /////////////////////////////////YOU ARE NOW OUT OF RANGE OF “USER2”
/////////////////////////////////YOU ARE NO LONGER SHARING YOUR SCREEN WITH “USER2”
